lessons.title: Workplace Safety: Inspections and Rules
lessons.objective: Learners will understand and use carry out an inspection and comply with the safety rules in workplace contexts.

reading.text: The workshop supervisor will carry out an inspection before a new machine is used. The team must comply with the safety rules, even when several orders are waiting. A short training session will show staff where to stop the machine and whom to contact if something goes wrong. The supervisor will ask a colleague to check that the written instructions match the controls on the machine.

sentences.text: The workshop supervisor will carry out an inspection before a new machine is used.
The team must comply with the safety rules, even when several orders are waiting.
A short training session will show staff where to stop the machine and whom to contact if something goes wrong.
The supervisor will ask a colleague to check that the written instructions match the controls on the machine.

targets.meaningEn: to perform a careful check or examination
to obey or follow the safety rules
targets.meaningVi: tuân thủ các quy tắc an toàn

exercises.prompt: In "The workshop supervisor will carry out an inspection before a new machine is used," what does "carry out an inspection" mean?

options.text: It means he will perform a careful check of the machine before use.
options.explanation: This is correct because it matches to perform a careful check or examination.

options.text: It means he will cancel the planned check because the machine is new.
options.explanation: This is wrong because cancel is the opposite of performing a check.

options.text: It means he will move the machine to another room for storage.
options.explanation: This is wrong because moving for storage does not mean performing a check.

exercises.explanation: The phrase means to perform a careful check before use.

exercises.prompt: Choose the natural sentence using "carry out an inspection".

options.text: The engineer will carry out an inspection of the bridge tomorrow morning.
options.explanation: This is correct because the verb form and collocation inspection of are natural.

options.text: The engineer will carry out an inspection about the bridge tomorrow morning.
options.explanation: Wrong: For the object being examined, inspection of the bridge is natural; about does not express that relation naturally here.

options.text: The engineer will carries out an inspection of the bridge tomorrow morning.
options.explanation: This is wrong because carries should be corrected to carry after will.

exercises.explanation: Only one sentence uses the phrase with correct grammar and collocation.

exercises.prompt: In "The team must comply with the safety rules, even when several orders are waiting," what does "comply with the safety rules" mean?

options.text: It means the team must obey and follow the safety rules despite the pressure.
options.explanation: This is correct because it matches to obey or follow the safety rules.

options.text: It means the team may ignore the safety rules to finish orders faster.
options.explanation: This is wrong because ignore is the opposite of obeying the rules.

options.text: It means the team must write new safety rules for future orders.
options.explanation: This is wrong because writing new rules does not mean following existing rules.

exercises.explanation: The phrase means to obey and follow the safety rules.

exercises.prompt: Choose the natural sentence using "comply with the safety rules".

options.text: All visitors must comply to the safety rules in the laboratory.
options.explanation: This is wrong because to should be corrected to with after comply.

options.text: All visitors must comply with the safety rules in the laboratory.
options.explanation: This is correct because the verb form and collocation comply with are natural.

options.text: All visitors must complies with the safety rules in the laboratory.
options.explanation: This is wrong because complies should be corrected to comply after must.

exercises.explanation: Only one sentence uses the phrase with correct grammar and collocation.

exercises.prompt: You are a hotel guest writing a short message to a friend about the swimming pool. Write 2-3 sentences describing the pool rules and what guests do. Use the phrase 'comply with the safety rules'.
exercises.sampleAnswer: I tried the hotel pool yesterday and the lifeguards are very strict. Everyone has to comply with the safety rules, so we watched a short safety video before swimming.
